title: La fiesta sorpresa
setting: Emma ha visto en Instagram las fotos de tu fiesta de cumpleaños y te pregunta por ella.

says.t: Happy birthday, Yolanda! I saw the photos. Was it a surprise party?
says.es: ¡Feliz cumpleaños, Yolanda! He visto las fotos. ¿Era una fiesta sorpresa?

options.t: Thank you! Yes, it was organised by my son.
Thank you! Yes, it was organise by my son.
options.feedback: Falta la -d del participio: was organised.

options.t: Thank you! Yes, it was organised for my son.
options.feedback: For = para. Quien la organizó va con by: by my son.

options.t: All my friends were invited. And the neighbours!
options.es: Invitaron a todas mis amigas. ¡Y a los vecinos!

options.t: All my friends was invited. And the neighbours!

says.t: That cake looks amazing. Where was it bought?
says.es: Esa tarta tiene una pinta increíble. ¿Dónde la compraron?

options.t: It wasn't bought. It was made by my grandson!
options.es: No la compraron. ¡La hizo mi nieto!

options.t: It wasn't bought. It was make by my grandson!

says.t: Wow! How many candles were there?

options.t: Only one! The others were forgotten at home.
options.es: ¡Solo una! Las demás se quedaron olvidadas en casa.
